name: Meta Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent launched in beta on August 5, 2026. Powered by the Muse Spark 1.2 multimodal reasoning model, it's a terminal-based coding agent designed for agentic tasks with major gains in tool and computer use, coding, and multimodal understanding. It can plan changes across codebases, write and edit code, debug, validate changes, and handle complex software tasks while undercutting rivals on price.
community_quotes: Meta is explicitly targeting Anthropic and OpenAI's coding AI offerings
Designed to compete directly with established coding agents

name: Alibaba Qwen3-Coder
description: Alibaba's most advanced agentic AI coding model unveiled in August 2026. During the week of August 3-9, 2026, Alibaba open-sourced a 2.4-trillion-parameter model built for long-running software work. Alibaba shipped AI coding agent updates within 72 hours of competitors (Meta and Anthropic), with pricing at US$2.50 per million input tokens and US$7.50 per million output tokens. Alibaba Cloud was named a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, ranked #1 in APAC.
community_quotes: Three major launches within 72 hours (Meta, Anthropic, and Alibaba) caused a price shift in the market
Alibaba tested 18 AI coding agents on 100 real codebases over 8 months
Ranked #1 in APAC by Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents
